data.title: 白面鸮 · 数据整理完毕
data.description: 最后一份记录归档后，她合上文件夹，宣布本次整理完成，准备去喝水。
data.camera: 中景，文件夹与桌面同框
data.promptProse: At a sleek laboratory terminal, Ptilopsis snaps a bulky research folder shut as on-screen diagnostic charts settle into standby mode. A desktop organizer holding stylus pens and data chips gleams beside her keyboard in the fading blue twilight.
data.animaCaption: With the final data batch logged, she firmly closes the binder and exhales quietly, concluding her analytical cycle for the day.
